candidates.text: When dispatching a live Engineer or Quality Engineer for a task that will request test-runner commands, state explicitly in the dispatch prompt that working_directory must be a relative path (e.g. 'demo-repo'), matching this repo's established convention -- engineer.md's own 'Command grammar' section documents the command string's grammar in detail but is silent on working_directory's relative/absolute requirement, so a live agent may reasonably supply an absolute path, producing an avoidable command_rejected that halts the phase outright (per the command_rejected escalation rule) rather than being repaired by the orchestrator.
